theater: 上美索不達米亞埃德薩

battle.name: 塔努基茲對羅馬的起義
battle.theater: 上美索不達米亞埃德薩
battle.brief: 西元378年，沙漠部落塔努基茲人在女王瑪維婭率領下起兵，包圍上美索不達米亞重鎮埃德薩；羅馬派出解圍縱隊，接觸前以輕型弩砲覆蓋城郊營地，迫圍城方收兵，終以償付欠款與歸還人質議和收場，史料只留下夜襲斬殺約百人的記載。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰的一方是東羅馬帝國，首都君士坦丁堡，東半部的最高統帥是皇帝瓦倫斯，他自364年起坐鎮安條克，東方軍政的運作由安條克的樞密與總督層級處理；前線由奧斯羅埃尼亞行省的軍事總督率領的邊防軍擔任，埃德薩城本身是帝國在美索不達米亞的關鍵據點，兼管幼發拉底河中游的關稅與軍糧徵收，羅馬在城內駐有步兵、騎兵與輔助軍，隨軍配備扭力弩砲等輕型投射兵器，以及繩梯、木製攻城塔一類的攻城器材。另一方是塔努基茲人，這是敘利亞沙漠中以帕爾米拉為核心的一支阿拉伯部落聯盟，平日受羅馬招撫，作為邊境盟友用來對抗波斯，兵員以輕裝騎兵、弓箭手與徒步步卒為主，配標槍、短彎刀與皮甲，營帳與糧秣靠駱駝馱運，沒有大型攻城器械。部落並非國家，沒有固定國界，實際上以瑪維婭率領的帳營為中樞，各分支部族聽命於女王與族長，決策靠部落會議與使節往還，與羅馬的關係則透過安條克的外交官與軍需官員維持。
countriesEn: The Roman Empire and the Tanukhids fought in Upper Mesopotamia in 378. On the Roman side the empire was governed from Constantinople, but the eastern half was run in practice from Antioch, where Emperor Valens had his headquarters since 364; the chain of command ran from the emperor through the praetorian and consular prefects down to the dux of Osrhoene, whose border garrison held Edessa, the empire's key city on the middle Euphrates and the seat of the customs and grain levies for the whole district. The garrison there consisted of regular infantry, cavalry and auxilia, and it carried the standard light artillery of the late Roman army, torsion bolt-throwers, together with ladders and timber towers for siege work. Against them stood the Tanukhids, a confederation of Arab tribes based in the Syrian desert around Palmyra, long employed by Rome as frontier allies against the Persians. Their fighting strength was light cavalry, archers and footmen with javelins, sabres and leather armour; they moved by camel and camped in tents, and they owned no heavy artillery and no siege engines. The confederation was not a state: it had no fixed frontier, its centre of gravity was the encampment of Queen Mavia, and decisions rested on a council of tribal leaders, while its dealings with Rome ran through envoys and military supply officers stationed at Antioch.
people: 瑪維婭是塔努基茲人的女王，丈夫死後以寡婦身分接過部落的率領權柄，是這場起義的發動者。她先前作為羅馬的邊境盟友，率部眾參與羅馬對波斯的戰事，屢次立功；起義爆發時她以女王身分強硬追討酬金，羅馬方面的將領又扣住她的兩個兒子作人質不肯交還，一旁還有對她抱怨的羅馬官員把帝國要消滅部落的說法散播出去，這段煽動把僵局推到破裂邊緣。瓦倫斯是東方的皇帝，圍城之際他駐在安條克，負責調兵解圍、派使議和與批准條款，之後他率軍北上，於378年8月9日在阿德里安堡與哥特人交戰時陣亡。狄奧多西一世在378年11月接掌帝國，379年與瓦倫斯瓜分東方，383年重新統一帝國；後來正是他在塔努基茲人再度舉兵時派遣遠征大軍平定。扎卜迪爾是瑪維婭的姪兒，也在埃德薩教會擔任執事，他奉命出使羅軍營談成協議，瑪維婭死後他接掌部落，並在379至380年間再圍埃德薩，最後戰死陣中；其弟薩克亞克繼位，選擇納貢議和。羅馬方面的前線指揮官是奧斯羅埃尼亞的軍事總督，姓名未流傳，另有皇帝派出的使者參與談判。關於此事的原始記載主要來自索佐門《教會史》第十四卷與狄奧多勒《教會史》第四卷，阿米安努斯·馬塞里努斯亦有相關敘述。
peopleEn: Mavia, queen of the Tanukhids, took over the leadership of the tribe after the death of her husband and became the spark of the revolt. As a Roman client she had led her people in Roman campaigns against Persia and had a record of service; when the rising began she pressed hard in her capacity as queen for the money the empire owed, while the Roman authorities held her two sons as hostages and would not give them up, and a Roman official with a grudge against her passed round the saying that the emperor meant to destroy the tribe. That agitation pushed the deadlock to the point of rupture. Valens, emperor of the East, was at Antioch while the siege stood and handled the dispatch of the relieving force, the envoys and the terms of the settlement; he then marched north and was killed at the Battle of Adrianople on 9 August 378. Theodosius I took the purple in November 378, divided the empire with Valens in 379 and reunited it in 383, and it was he who sent the expedition that ended the second phase of the revolt. Zabdiel, Mavia's nephew and a deacon of the church of Edessa, was the emissary who negotiated the agreement with the Roman camp; after Mavia's death he inherited the tribe, besieged Edessa again between 379 and 380, and was killed in the fighting. His brother Saqyaq succeeded him and chose to sue for peace. On the Roman side the field commander was the dux of Osrhoene, whose name has not survived, together with envoys sent by the emperor. Our principal sources are Sozomen's Church History, book 14, and Theodoret's Church History, book 4, with Ammianus Marcellinus also touching on the affair.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲就是戰役體系裡的火力節點。它是扭力式投射器，機身靠扭簧把儲存的彈力轉成瞬間的發射能量，一發一具箭，每具由三至四名操作手推動、操作絞盤定位，箭身約六尺、羽翎與鐵鏃合計約一磅重，維特魯維奧斯《建築十書》所記的有效射程約兩百步，正好覆蓋接觸前的距離。到四世紀，它已經從希臘時期用來拆城牆的攻城器械，轉成每個軍團都配備的輕型野戰砲：韋蓋提烏斯《兵法概論》說它配置在陣列前緣與兩翼，用來在對方逼近之前先打散密集隊形，同樣可以用來射擊成群的攻城兵與雲梯。史料並沒有記下這場衝突裡弩砲的實際使用，但可以確定的是，羅馬解圍的縱隊屬於帝國邊防軍，必須攜帶這類輕型投射兵器；羅馬一方同時裝備塔盾、短劍、投槍，以及鎖子甲與鱗甲的騎兵裝具，並攜帶繩梯、木製攻城塔與帳篷，用於應付圍城者的攻城嘗試，補充給養由幼發拉底河與安條克方向沿河谷運上來。塔努基茲人一側則是另一套裝備體系，輕裝弓弩手、標槍手、佩短彎刀與皮甲的騎兵，沒有一具弩砲或投石機，也沒有攻城塔，只有帳幕、旗幟與駱駝隊，用來在沙漠中快速機動與搬運糧水。
kitsEn: The card's piece, the Roman scorpio, is the firepower hinge of the order of battle. It is a torsion engine: the frame stores elastic energy in twisted skeins of sinew and hair, and the winch converts that into a single shot per reload, one bolt to a machine. Three or four men crewed each piece, the arrow was about six feet long and about a pound in weight, and Vitruvius gives its effective range as roughly two hundred paces, exactly the distance that has to be covered before contact. By the fourth century the type had moved on from its Hellenic phase as an engine for breaking city walls and had become the standard light field gun of every legion: Vegetius describes it in the front of the formation and on the wings, used to break up massed formations before the enemy closes, and equally usable against assault troops and scaling ladders. The sources do not record the actual use of the scorpio in this conflict, but what can be said with certainty is that the relieving column was a frontier force of the empire and must have carried such light artillery. The Roman side also had scuta, gladii and pila, mail and scale armour for the cavalry, and took ladders, wooden towers and tenting along for any attempt at siege, with the supplies coming up the Euphrates valley from Antioch. The Tanukhids fielded light bowmen, javelin men and sabre-armed leather-armoured horsemen, with not a single bolt-thrower or stone thrower and no siege towers, only tents, standards and camel trains for fast movement and for carrying food and water across the desert.
tactics: 整場衝突可以分成兩段，羅馬兩段的戰法都不相同。第一段是解圍：羅軍部隊沿幼發拉底河兩岸北上，收攏在埃德薩城郊的阿拉伯營地之前，選在夜裡發動攻擊，步兵在羅軍旗幟前列陣推進，輕裝部隊同時從兩翼插入營地與城牆之間，把圍城陣線切斷；索佐門記載這次夜襲斬殺了約一百名圍城者，羅軍隨即退回城內，圍城解除。進攻序列裡，弩砲一類的輕型投射兵器通常排在最前面，用來在接觸之前先以箭雨覆蓋敵方營地，逼對方放棄開闊位置、退回帳幕之間，等羅軍步兵進入弩箭射程死角再短兵相接。第二段是反攻與議和：羅馬在談判同時分化鄰近的阿拉伯部落，讓與埃德薩有世仇的部族不再替塔努基茲人出力；瑪維婭去世後，扎卜迪爾再率部眾圍城，這次帝國派出的遠征大軍在野外戰中擊潰他們，扎卜迪爾陣亡，餘部由薩克亞克率領，向羅馬請求議和並交納貢賦。兩次圍城的技術層面幾乎沒有攻城術的內容：塔努基茲人靠封鎖城郊水源與道路、用騎兵巡邏切斷糧道來施壓，羅馬則靠城外營地的反擊與政治分化解決問題，兵器系統的重點落在短程投射與騎兵機動，而不是攻城塔與撞槌。
tacticsEn: The conflict can be split into two phases, and Rome fought the two very differently. The first was the relief of Edessa: the Roman column moved up both banks of the Euphrates, closed on the Arab encampment outside the city and attacked at night, with the infantry advancing in formation behind the Roman standards while light troops pushed in on both flanks between the camp and the walls, cutting the line of encirclement. Sozomen records about a hundred of the besiegers killed in that night attack, after which the Romans withdrew inside the walls and the siege was lifted. In the order of attack, light artillery such as the scorpio would normally be placed in front, covering the enemy camp with a shower of bolts so as to push them out of open ground and back between their tents, and only then would the Roman infantry close through the dead ground of the bolt's own range. The second phase was counter-attack and negotiation: while talks went on, Rome worked on the neighbouring Arab tribes and deprived the Tanukhids of the support of a people permanently hostile to Edessa. After Mavia's death Zabdiel led his people against the city once more, and this time the expedition sent by the empire broke them in the open field, Zabdiel fell, and the survivors under Saqyaq asked for peace and paid tribute. There is almost no siegecraft in either siege: the Tanukhids put pressure on Edessa by sealing the water and the roads around it and patrolling with cavalry to cut the food supply, while Rome solved the problem with a counter-stroke against the camp outside the walls and with political division. The weight of the fighting therefore falls on short-range artillery and cavalry manoeuvre rather than on towers and rams.
data: 可核對的數字不多，先說年份：起義與第一次圍城發生在378年，議和與瑪維婭受洗也在378年之內，扎卜迪爾再度起兵為379至380年，薩克亞克議和後這支部落重新回到羅馬的盟友名冊。索佐門留下的唯一具體傷亡數字，是羅軍夜襲斬殺約一百名圍城者，這個數字在教會史寫作裡常被引用，但沒有給出羅軍自身的損失，也沒有說明包圍埃德薩的塔努基茲人到底有多少兵馬；史料對羅馬承諾給瑪維婭的酬金只說是一筆可觀的金額並附帶土地，沒有留下確切的錢數。弩砲的技術參數反而有古代文獻可依：維特魯維奧斯記小型弩砲所發之箭約六尺長、一磅重，射程約兩百步，操作需三至四人，一發一箭，這個規格到四世紀基本沒有改變。與這場起義同期而規模大得多的帝國災難是阿德里安堡之戰，瓦倫斯於378年8月9日陣亡，羅馬軍的損失在古代記錄與現代估算之間從一萬餘到四萬人不等，估計差距正說明這類數字只能當作量級參考；同一年羅馬在萊茵、多瑙河與高加索方向還要同時應付西哥特人、東哥特人與匈人的壓力，能調給上美索不達米亞的部隊因此十分有限。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and the year comes first: the revolt and the first siege of Edessa belong to 378, the negotiated settlement and Mavia's baptism also fall inside that year, Zabdiel's renewed rising covers 379 to 380, and after Saqyaq's submission the tribe appears once more on the roll of Roman allies. The only concrete casualty figure preserved by Sozomen is that the night attack killed about a hundred of the besiegers; the figure is constantly quoted from the ecclesiastical history, but it gives no losses on the Roman side and no indication of how many Tanukhids actually surrounded Edessa, and the sources describe the money the Romans promised Mavia only as a considerable sum together with land, without an exact figure. The technical parameters of the bolt-thrower are on firmer ground: Vitruvius records the small scorpio's arrow as about six feet long and one pound in weight, with a range of about two hundred paces, worked by three or four men, one bolt to a shot, a specification essentially unchanged by the fourth century. The disaster of the same year, far greater in scale, was the Battle of Adrianople, where Valens fell on 9 August 378; Roman losses are given from a little over ten thousand to forty thousand depending on whether one follows the ancient accounts or modern estimates, and the width of that range shows that such numbers can only be used as orders of magnitude. In the same year Rome was also facing West Goths, East Goths and Huns along the Rhine, the Danube and the Caucasus, and the troops that could be found for the east were correspondingly few.
cause: 這場起義的直接起因是羅馬沒有履行對沙漠盟友的承諾。塔努基茲人多年來為帝國充當邊境打手，羅馬需要他們牽制波斯與阿拉伯其他部落，也要他們在沙漠道路上攔截敵方信使與商隊；作為交換，帝國承諾支付酬金，並在帝國邊境劃出土地安置這些部落。起義爆發時，這筆酬金並沒有如數交清，土地也沒有落實，於是部眾的怨氣集中在瑪維婭身上；她以女王身分強行追討，羅馬方面的將領又扣住她的兩個兒子作人質，僵局由此形成。催化這次破裂的還有同一年的戰局：378年羅馬在巴爾幹被哥特人拖住，東方的皇帝遠在西邊，多瑙河與高加索的邊境同時告急，能調動的兵力極其有限，帝國只能靠安條克的使節、錢財與盟族之間的互相猜忌來處理上美索不達米亞的局面。制度層面上，這也是晚期羅馬邊疆治理模式的固有弱點：羅馬從來不把沙漠部落收編為常備軍，而是用金錢、稱號與人質維持忠誠，一旦現金流斷掉，督戰的將領又與部落首領交惡，聯盟就會在一夜之間翻面。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the revolt was Rome's failure to honour its promises to its desert allies. The Tanukhids had long served the empire as border fighters: Rome needed them to contain Persia and the other Arab tribes, to patrol the desert roads and to intercept enemy messengers and caravans, and in return the empire had promised them money and land inside the imperial frontier. When the revolt broke out that money had not been paid in full and the land had not been granted, so the anger of the rank and file settled on Mavia; she demanded satisfaction in her capacity as queen, and the Roman authorities were holding her two sons as hostages, which made the deadlock complete. The same year's strategic situation supplied the spark: in 378 Rome was bogged down in the Balkans against the Goths while the emperor of the East was far away in the west, the Danube and the Caucasus frontiers were in simultaneous alarm, and very few troops could be transferred to the east. The empire could therefore manage Upper Mesopotamia only through Antioch's envoys, money and the mutual suspicion of its client peoples. At the institutional level this was also the standing weakness of late Roman frontier management: Rome never incorporated desert tribes into a standing army but held their loyalty with cash, titles and hostages, and once the flow of money stopped, and the supervising officer happened to be at odds with the tribal chief, the alliance could turn over in a single night.
impact: 對羅馬帝國來說，這場起義的直接代價是錢與面子，一次圍城、一次賠款、一次遠征，換回來的只是讓邊境重新安靜下來。真正深遠的影響有兩層。第一層在美索不達米亞：塔努基茲人從臨時徵用的盟友，變成羅馬正式承認的定居邊界守衛者，首領獲得奧古斯塔與帕特里克斯一類的羅馬尊號，部落在帝國邊境內得到土地與牧場，並且被要求像帝國的屬民那樣生活與作戰；這批騎兵此後長期是安條克與君士坦丁堡兩個方向的重要機動力量，帝國的東方邊境因此多出一層以盟族代替常備軍的緩衝。第二層在宗教與城市史上：瑪維婭受洗，埃德薩境內興建教會，埃德薩這座敘利亞腹地的城市教會因而成為東方的教會中心之一，與亞歷山大、安條克的教會往來密切，敘利亞方言的早期基督教文獻也在這個背景下流通開來。宏觀上，這次叛亂是晚期羅馬以金錢換安寧的邊疆策略最典型的一次示範：帝國在失去皇帝瓦倫斯、阿德里安堡慘敗之後，被迫承認自己在東方的盟族只要有足夠武裝，就足以動搖行省，於是此後的政策更倚重賄賂、使節與分化，而不是正面投入遠征。
impactEn: For the Roman Empire the price of this rising was money and prestige: one siege, one indemnity and one expedition bought nothing more than a quiet frontier. The deeper effects work on two levels. The first is in Mesopotamia: the Tanukhids changed from allies hired for the occasion into settled guardians of the frontier formally recognised by Rome; their chiefs received Roman titles of the order of Augusta and patrix, the tribe was given land and pastures inside the imperial border, and they were expected to live and fight like subjects of the empire. Those horsemen were for a long time an important mobile force in the directions of Antioch and Constantinople, and the eastern frontier gained a buffer made of client cavalry in place of a standing army. The second level is religious and urban: Mavia was baptised and a church was founded in her honour in the territory of Edessa, and the church of that city in the Syrian interior became one of the centres of the eastern churches, in close contact with Alexandria and Antioch, while the earliest Christian literature in the Syro-Aramaic vernacular circulated in the same setting. On a larger scale the revolt is the clearest demonstration of the late Roman strategy of buying peace with money: having lost Valens and been mauled at Adrianople, the empire had to admit that a single armed client people in the east was enough to shake a province, and policy from then on leaned even more heavily on bribes, embassies and division than on committing forces in person.
result: 結果是三段式的。第一次圍城以羅馬解圍收場，瑪維婭同意讓出兩名兒子、接納基督教，羅馬則補上拖欠的酬金並撥出土地，授予她奧古斯塔與帕特里克斯的尊號，瑪維婭不久之後去世。第二次起義以扎卜迪爾的敗亡告終：379至380年間他再率塔努基茲人圍困埃德薩，帝國這次調動的遠征大軍在野外交戰中擊潰並殺死他，弟弟薩克亞克接位，選擇向羅馬請和、繳納貢賦並重新接受盟約。最終的格局是，塔努基茲人重新回到羅馬的友邦名冊，身份由游動的沙漠盟友變成有土地、有尊號、受羅馬節制的前線部隊；對羅馬而言，埃德薩之圍沒有被記入那些被記念的大戰役之列，因為打贏的代價是一筆金錢加上一次遠征，而不是佔領土地；對雙方而言，這一場衝突真正留下的，是一套帝國用錢與盟約、部落用騎兵與條件來交換邊界安寧的做法，羅馬在東方的朝貢體系此後會越來越依賴這些沙漠部落的忠誠。
resultEn: The outcome came in three stages. The first siege ended with the relief of Edessa: Mavia agreed to give up her two sons and to accept Christianity, while Rome paid the money it owed and granted land, conferring on her the titles of Augusta and patrix; she died shortly afterwards. The second rising ended with Zabdiel's destruction: between 379 and 380 he besieged Edessa once more with the Tanukhids, the expedition dispatched by the empire broke him and killed him in open battle, and his brother Saqyaq took over, asked for peace, paid tribute and accepted the alliance anew. The end result was that the Tanukhids were back on the roll of Roman friends, their role transformed from a roving desert ally into a forward force with land, titles and Roman discipline. For Rome the siege of Edessa does not appear among the great battles that are remembered, because what it cost was a sum of money and an expedition rather than any conquered territory; for both sides what the conflict really left behind was a working system in which the empire exchanged money and treaties for the tribes' cavalry and conditions, and the tribute system of the Roman east grew ever more dependent on the loyalty of these desert peoples.
